table_44_cross_check.finding: AbilityProgressionTunable exists in every M19-M27 and CFB27 schema. Madden retains six identical fields through M27; CFB27 retains the table name but changes its asset ID and fields. This strongly supports an EA table-family origin for the historical Table_44 artifact, but does not prove row-level identity.
